t: A pocket AI camera with a touchscreen that spots objects and faces.
steps: Buy the MaixCAM kit from the Sipeed store or a maker shop.
Check that a microSD card with the system is in the slot.
Download the free MaixVision app on your computer.
Connect the kit to your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open MaixVision and connect to the camera.
Run the YOLO object detection example and watch it label things on the screen.
Change the example to count only people or only cups.
Browse MaixHub for ready-made apps and models to try next.
